title: Policy
description: Autonomy policy (PRD 10.4): a user's pre-authorisation of one action type within a scope and limits. Data only: the deterministic policy engine decides, a model never does, and a T3 action never runs above L1. $defs.risk_tier_table is the shape of the risk tiers in config/autonomy.yaml.

undo_window_s.description: Seconds an L2 action can still be undone.

expiry.description: When the policy stops applying, or null for no expiry.

team_lead_domains.description: Expert domains (PRD 8.3, for example security or finance; not email domains, which are scope.domains) whose Team Leads may open this action type's gates in the owner's worlds (PRD 10.1: 'in their domain, if the policy allows'). Empty lets no Team Lead open them. The owner, and an Approver the gate names, need no policy. Like scope, read from the current record (outbox OB-01).

history.description: Every change, oldest first, starting with the creation, so never empty: each entry's at is no earlier than the one before, and the record's level equals the last entry's level (validator, outbox OB-01). The level in force at a time is the level of the last entry at or before it; a revocation or Stop all autopilot is an entry at L1 (policy.changed). Only the owner creates and changes a policy (PRD 10.1; a Team Lead only proposes), so every entry's by, like created_by.by and changed_by.by, equals owner; a record that breaks this covers nothing (validator, outbox OB-01).

then.description: A policy that acts without a person at the gate needs a daily limit: L3 standing rules (FR-HIL-06) and L2 (BQ-30).

scope.description: Where the policy applies. An empty recipients, domains or districts list means no restriction on that dimension.

per_day.description: Most actions per day, or null for no daily cap.

credits.description: Most credits per day spent by actions under this policy, or null.

conditions.description: Always true: attachments, new recipients and safety-flagged content are T3 (PRD 10.4), and T3 never runs above L1, so no policy can pre-authorise them.

risk_tier_table.description: Risk tiers (PRD 10.4): each action type's base tier, the context modifiers that raise any action to T3, and the highest level each tier allows. A modifier applies whatever the base tier, so a deletion or an external share is T3 even when its action type is listed lower.

modifiers.description: All six PRD 10.4 T3 conditions, each exactly once: six unique items over a closed six-value enum with a fixed raises_to, so none can be dropped.

tier_condition.description: A PRD 10.4 context condition that raises any action to T3; also listed on the outbox entry it applies to (outbox.schema.json modifiers).

max_level.description: Highest autonomy level per tier; T3 is always L1 (a person).
